title: Global Sustainability Challenge 2026–27
summary: Design, build and test a real-world sustainability solution with a Stanford-led international network.
eligibility: Global university students; at least one member 18 by 1 January 2027; account-holder age conditions also apply.

prize.description: Over US$35,000 reported prize pool; verify the current division / reward rules.

notes: Challenge-hub signup is available, but separate team registration needs confirmation.
